the clause is conjoined, and يلبثون is the apodosis of an implied law. ﴿خِلافَكَ﴾: an adverb attached to يلبثون, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿قَلِيلًا﴾: an adjective (ṣifa) of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), its implied form being "إلّا لبثا قليلا". ﴿سُنَّةَ﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq of an omitted verb, its implied form being "سنّ الله ذلك سنة". ﴿مَنْ﴾: a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿قَدْ﴾: a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿أَرْسَلْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿قَبْلَكَ﴾: قبل is an adverb of time attached to أرسلنا, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مِنْ رُسُلِنا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), and نا is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَلا تَجِدُ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, lā is negative, and تجد is an imperfect verb, nominative, whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is conjoined. ﴿لِسُنَّتِنا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تجد, and نا is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿تَحْوِيلًا﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿أَقِمِ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿الصَّلاةَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿لِدُلُوكِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أقم, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi [Translator's note: so in the source; there is no pronoun kāf in لدلوك]. ﴿الشَّمْسِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِلى غَسَقِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أقم. ﴿اللَّيْلِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَقُرْآنَ﴾: conjoined to الصلاة. ﴿الْفَجْرِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِنَّ قُرْآنَ﴾: inna and its noun. ﴿الْفَجْرِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿كانَ مَشْهُوداً﴾: kāna and its khabar (predicate), and its noun is omitted; the clause is the khabar of inna, and the inna clause gives the reason and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:79-81.t: ﴿وَمِنَ اللَّيْلِ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq) to تهجد. ﴿فَتَهَجَّدْ﴾: the fāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), and an imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is conjoined to أقم. ﴿بِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تهجد. ﴿نافِلَةً﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿لَكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to نافلة. ﴿عَسى﴾: a complete (tāmm) past verb. ﴿أَنْ يَبْعَثَكَ﴾: an puts the verb in the accusative, and an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), whose fāʿil is latent, and the kāf is its object; the clause is the fāʿil of عسى. ﴿رَبُّكَ﴾: the fāʿil of يبعث, nominative (marfūʿ), and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿مَقاماً﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because whoever "raises you" [يبعثك] "makes you stand" [يقيم]. ﴿مَحْمُوداً﴾: an adjective (ṣifa) of مقاما. ﴿وَقُلْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined. ﴿رَبِّ﴾: the one addressed (munādā) with an omitted vocative particle, accusative by an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the letter before the first-person yāʾ, which was deleted for lightness; it is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿أَدْخِلْنِي﴾: a verb of supplication; the nūn is for protection (al-wiqāya), the yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is latent; the clause is the speech reported. ﴿مُدْخَلَ﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq. ﴿صِدْقٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَأَخْرِجْنِي مُخْرَجَ صِدْقٍ﴾: its i'rab is like the preceding one, and it is conjoined to it. ﴿وَاجْعَلْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and a verb of supplication whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿لِي﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to اجعل. ﴿مِنْ لَدُنْكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to اجعل, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿سُلْطاناً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿نَصِيراً﴾: an adjective of سلطانا. ﴿وَقُلْ﴾: its i'rab is at the beginning of the previous verse. ﴿جاءَ الْحَقُّ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the speech reported. ﴿وَزَهَقَ الْباطِلُ﴾: conjoined to what preceded. ﴿إِنَّ الْباطِلَ﴾: inna and its noun, and the clause gives the reason and has no grammatical position. ﴿كانَ زَهُوقاً﴾: kāna and its khabar (predicate), and its noun is omitted, the implied form being "كان هو"; the clause is the khabar of inna.

daas-irab:82-84.t: ﴿وَنُنَزِّلُ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive. ﴿مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached (mutaʿalliq) to ننزل. ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿هُوَ شِفاءٌ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate), and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَرَحْمَةٌ﴾: maʿṭūf (conjoined) to شفاء. ﴿لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to رحمة. ﴿وَلا يَزِيدُ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, lā is negative, and يزيد is an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿الظَّالِمِينَ﴾: first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿خَساراً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَإِذا﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and إذا is an adverb containing the sense of condition. ﴿أَنْعَمْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿عَلَى الْإِنْسانِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أنعمنا. ﴿أَعْرَضَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿وَنَأى﴾: conjoined to أعرض. ﴿بِجانِبِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to نأى. ﴿وَإِذا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and إذا is an adverb containing the sense of condition. ﴿مَسَّهُ﴾: a past verb and its object. ﴿الشَّرُّ﴾: fāʿil, and the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿كانَ يَؤُساً﴾: kāna and its khabar, and its noun is omitted; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿قُلْ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿كُلٌّ﴾: mubtadaʾ, and the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿يَعْمَلُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is the khabar. ﴿عَلى شاكِلَتِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يعمل, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; and the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَرَبُّكُمْ أَعْلَمُ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and mubtadaʾ and khabar; the clause is conjoined. ﴿بِمَنْ﴾: من is a relative noun, and the two are attached to أعلم. ﴿هُوَ﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿أَهْدى﴾: khabar, nominative (marfūʿ) by an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif because of impossibility; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿سَبِيلًا﴾: tamyīz (specification).

daas-irab:85-87.t: ﴿وَيَسْئَلُونَكَ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its object; the clause is resumptive. ﴿عَنِ الرُّوحِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached (mutaʿalliq) to يسألونك. ﴿قُلِ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿الرُّوحِ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿مِنْ أَمْرِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the khabar (predicate). ﴿رَبِّي﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and mā is negative. ﴿أُوتِيتُمْ﴾: a passive past verb, and the tāʾ is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿مِنَ الْعِلْمِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أوتيتم. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿قَلِيلًا﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَلَئِنْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, the lām prepares for the oath (al-lām al-muwaṭṭiʾa li-l-qasam), and in is conditional. ﴿شِئْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya) and has no grammatical position. ﴿لَنَذْهَبَنَّ﴾: the lām occurs in the answer to the oath, and an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis, and its fāʿil is latent; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the answer to an oath. ﴿بِالَّذِي﴾: الذي is a relative noun, and the two are attached to نذهبن. ﴿أَوْحَيْنا إِلَيْكَ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to أوحينا. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿لا تَجِدُ﴾: lā is negative, and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿لَكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تجد, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿بِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تجد. ﴿عَلَيْنا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to وكيلا. ﴿وَكِيلًا﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction. ﴿رَحْمَةً﴾: mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). ﴿مِنْ رَبِّكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to رحمة, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِنَّ فَضْلَهُ﴾: inna and its noun, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿كانَ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, and its noun is omitted. ﴿عَلَيْكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to كبيرا. ﴿كَبِيراً﴾: the khabar of kāna; the kāna clause is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of inna, and the clause of inna and what follows it gives the reason (taʿlīliyya) and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:88-90.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَئِنِ﴾: the lām prepares for the oath (al-lām al-muwaṭṭiʾa li-l-qasam), and in is conditional. ﴿اجْتَمَعَتِ الْإِنْسُ﴾: a past verb, the tāʾ is for the feminine, and الإنس is the fāʿil; it is the fiʿl al-sharṭ (protasis), and the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya) and has no grammatical position. ﴿وَالْجِنُّ﴾: maʿṭūf (conjoined) to الإنس. ﴿عَلى﴾: a preposition. ﴿أَنْ﴾: puts the verb in the accusative. ﴿يَأْتُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by the deletion of the nūn; together with an it is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), genitive (majrūr) by على, and the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿بِمِثْلِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يأتوا. ﴿هذَا﴾: the hā is for drawing attention, and ذا is a demonstrative in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿الْقُرْآنِ﴾: badal (substitute) of the demonstrative. ﴿لا يَأْتُونَ﴾: lā is negative, and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the answer to the oath and has no grammatical position. ﴿بِمِثْلِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يأتون. ﴿وَلَوْ﴾: the wāw is of the ḥāl, and law is redundant (zāʾida). ﴿كانَ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿بَعْضُهُمْ﴾: the noun of kāna, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لِبَعْضٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ظهيرا. ﴿ظَهِيراً﴾: the khabar (predicate) of kāna. ﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, the lām prepares for the oath, and قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿صَرَّفْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿لِلنَّاسِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to صرفنا. ﴿فِي هذَا﴾: ذا is a demonstrative; the two are attached to صرفنا. ﴿الْقُرْآنِ﴾: badal of the demonstrative. ﴿مِنْ كُلِّ﴾: an adjective (ṣifa) of an implied mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿مَثَلٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَأَبى أَكْثَرُ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿النَّاسِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿كُفُوراً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَقالُوا﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَنْ﴾: puts the verb in the accusative. ﴿نُؤْمِنَ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative, and its fāʿil is latent. ﴿لَكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to نؤمن. ﴿حَتَّى﴾: a particle of limit and a preposition. ﴿تَفْجُرَ لَنا مِنَ الْأَرْضِ يَنْبُوعاً﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative, and its fāʿil is latent; لنا and من الأرض are both attached to the verb, and ينبوعا is mafʿūl bihi.

daas-irab:91-93.t: ﴿أَوْ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿تَكُونَ﴾: an imperfect incomplete (nāqiṣ) verb. ﴿لَكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached (mutaʿalliq) to the fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿جَنَّةٌ﴾: its postponed noun, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿مِنْ نَخِيلٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of جنة. ﴿وَعِنَبٍ﴾: maʿṭūf (conjoined) to نخيل. ﴿فَتُفَجِّرَ﴾: an imperfect verb conjoined to تكون, accusative (manṣūb) like it, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿الْأَنْهارَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿خِلالَها﴾: an adverb of place, and the hā is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿تَفْجِيراً﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿أَوْ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿تُسْقِطَ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿السَّماءَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿كَما﴾: the kāf is a preposition, and mā is maṣdariyya (forming a maṣdar). ﴿زَعَمْتَ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; mā and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of the genitive by the kāf, and the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿عَلَيْنا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تسقط. ﴿كِسَفاً﴾: ḥāl. ﴿أَوْ تَأْتِيَ﴾: أو is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined. ﴿بِاللَّهِ﴾: the Divine Name, genitive (majrūr) by the bāʾ; the two are attached to تأتي. ﴿وَالْمَلائِكَةِ﴾: conjoined. ﴿قَبِيلًا﴾: ḥāl. ﴿أَوْ يَكُونَ لَكَ بَيْتٌ﴾: أو is a conjunction, and the i'rab of this clause is like the i'rab of أو تكون لك جنة. ﴿مِنْ زُخْرُفٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective of بيت. ﴿أَوْ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿تَرْقى﴾: an imperfect verb conjoined to what preceded, accusative by an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the alif because of impossibility, and its fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فِي السَّماءِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ترقى. ﴿وَلَنْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and lan puts the verb in the accusative. ﴿نُؤْمِنَ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿لِرُقِيِّكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to نؤمن, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿حَتَّى﴾: a particle of limit and a preposition. ﴿تُنَزِّلَ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied an after حتى, and its fāʿil is latent. ﴿عَلَيْنا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تنزل. ﴿كِتاباً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿نَقْرَؤُهُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the hāʾ is its object; the clause is an adjective of كتابا. ﴿قُلْ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿سُبْحانَ﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq of an omitted verb. ﴿رَبِّي﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿هَلْ﴾: an interrogative particle. ﴿كُنْتُ﴾: kāna and its noun. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿بَشَراً﴾: the khabar of كنت. ﴿رَسُولًا﴾: an adjective.

daas-irab:94-96.t: ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and mā is negative. ﴿مَنَعَ﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿النَّاسَ﴾: first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿أَنْ يُؤْمِنُوا﴾: an puts the verb in the accusative, and an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an through the deletion of the nūn; an and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), the second mafʿūl bihi of منع. ﴿إِذْ﴾: an adverb of time attached (mutaʿalliq) to منع. ﴿جاءَهُمُ الْهُدى﴾: a past verb, its fronted object and its postponed fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ) by an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif because of impossibility; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿أَنْ﴾: maṣdariyya (forming a maṣdar). ﴿قالُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; an and what follows it are in the position of the nominative as the postponed fāʿil of منع, the implied form being "إلا قولهم" (except their saying). ﴿أَبَعَثَ اللَّهُ﴾: the hamza is interrogative, and a past verb, and the Divine Name is its fāʿil; the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿بَشَراً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿رَسُولًا﴾: an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿قُلْ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَوْ﴾: a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿كانَ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿مَلائِكَةٌ﴾: the noun of kāna. ﴿يَمْشُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is an adjective of الملائكة. ﴿مُطْمَئِنِّينَ﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿لَنَزَّلْنا﴾: the lām occurs in the apodosis of law, and a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ and ﴿مِنَ السَّماءِ﴾: the two prepositions and their genitive nouns are attached to نزلنا. ﴿مَلَكاً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿رَسُولًا﴾: an adjective. ﴿قُلْ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿كَفى﴾: a past verb, indeclinable on an implied fatḥa on the alif because of impossibility. ﴿بِاللَّهِ﴾: the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), and the Divine Name is the fāʿil. ﴿شَهِيداً﴾: tamyīz (specification). ﴿بَيْنِي﴾: an adverb of place, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and ﴿بَيْنَكُمْ﴾: conjoined to بيني; the clause is the speech reported. ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾: inna and its noun. ﴿كانَ﴾: an incomplete past verb, and its noun is omitted. ﴿بِعِبادِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to خبيرا. ﴿خَبِيراً﴾: the khabar of kāna, and the clause is the khabar of inna. ﴿بَصِيراً﴾: a second khabar.

daas-irab:97-98.t: ﴿وَمَنْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and من is a conditional noun that puts the verb in the jussive, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is resumptive. ﴿يَهْدِ اللَّهُ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the fiʿl al-sharṭ (protasis), its sign of the jussive being the deletion of the weak letter, and the Divine Name is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿فَهُوَ الْمُهْتَدِ﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis, and mubtadaʾ and khabar (predicate); the clause is in the position of the jussive as the jawāb al-sharṭ (apodosis), and the two clauses of the protasis and the apodosis are the khabar of من. ﴿وَمَنْ يُضْلِلْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and من is a conditional noun that puts the verb in the jussive, a mubtadaʾ. ﴿يُضْلِلْ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive because it is the fiʿl al-sharṭ, and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿فَلَنْ﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis, and lan puts the verb in the accusative. ﴿تَجِدَ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is in the position of the jussive as the jawāb al-sharṭ, and the two clauses of the protasis and the apodosis are the khabar of من. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached (mutaʿalliq) to تجد. ﴿أَوْلِياءَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿مِنْ دُونِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أولياء, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَنَحْشُرُهُمْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the hāʾ is its object. ﴿يَوْمَ﴾: an adverb of time attached to نحشرهم. ﴿الْقِيامَةِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَلى وُجُوهِهِمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿عُمْياً﴾: mafʿūl bihi [Translator's note: so in the source; عميا is usually parsed as a ḥāl]. ﴿وَبُكْماً وَصُمًّا﴾: conjoined to what preceded. ﴿مَأْواهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ﴾: mubtadaʾ and khabar, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿كُلَّما﴾: an adverb containing the sense of condition. ﴿خَبَتْ﴾: a past verb, the tāʾ is for the feminine, and the fāʿil is latent; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿زِدْناهُمْ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its first object, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿سَعِيراً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾: ذا is a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ, the lām is for distance and the kāf is for address. ﴿جَزاؤُهُمْ﴾: khabar, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿بِأَنَّهُمْ﴾: anna and its noun; it and what follows it are in the position of the genitive, and the two are attached to جزاؤهم. ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the khabar. ﴿بِآياتِنا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to كفروا, and نا is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَقالُوا﴾: the clause is conjoined. ﴿أَإِذا﴾: the hamza is interrogative, and إذا is an adverb containing the sense of condition. ﴿كُنَّا﴾: kāna and its noun, and the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عِظاماً﴾: mafʿūl bihi [Translator's note: so in the source; it is the khabar of كنا]. ﴿وَرُفاتاً﴾: conjoined to عظاما. ﴿أَإِنَّا﴾: the hamza is interrogative, and inna and its noun. ﴿لَمَبْعُوثُونَ﴾: the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and the khabar of inna, nominative (marfūʿ) by the wāw. ﴿خَلْقاً﴾: ḥāl. ﴿جَدِيداً﴾: an adjective (ṣifa); the speech after قالوا is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).

daas-irab:99-100.t: ﴿أَوَلَمْ﴾: the hamza is interrogative, the wāw is resumptive, and lam is a particle of negation, jussive and conversion (to the past). ﴿يَرَوْا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَنَّ اللَّهَ الَّذِي﴾: anna, and the Divine Name is its noun, and the relative noun is an adjective (ṣifa); anna and what follows it take the place of the two objects of يروا. ﴿خَلَقَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿السَّماواتِ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) by the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural. ﴿وَالْأَرْضَ﴾: maʿṭūf (conjoined) to السموات. ﴿قادِرٌ﴾: the khabar (predicate) of anna. ﴿عَلى أَنْ يَخْلُقَ﴾: an puts the verb in the accusative, and an imperfect verb, accusative, and its fāʿil is latent; an and what follows it are in the position of the genitive, and the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to قادر. ﴿مِثْلَهُمْ﴾: mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَجَعَلَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to جعل. ﴿أَجَلًا﴾: mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿لا رَيْبَ﴾: lā is the lā of generic negation, and ريب is its noun. ﴿فِيهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the khabar, and the clause is an adjective of أجلا. ﴿فَأَبَى الظَّالِمُونَ إِلَّا كُفُوراً﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and أبى is a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the alif because of impossibility, and الظالمون is the fāʿil, and إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr), and كفورا is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿قُلْ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَوْ﴾: a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿أَنْتُمْ﴾: tawkīd (emphasis) of the fāʿil omitted together with its verb, because law enters upon the verb, and the clause [Translator's note: so in the source]; the omitted clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya) and has no grammatical position. ﴿تَمْلِكُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is explicative (tafsīriyya). ﴿خَزائِنَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿رَحْمَةِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿رَبِّي﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِذاً﴾: a particle of answer. ﴿لَأَمْسَكْتُمْ﴾: the lām occurs in the apodosis of law, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of law. ﴿خَشْيَةَ﴾: mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). ﴿الْإِنْفاقِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَكانَ الْإِنْسانُ قَتُوراً﴾: kāna, its noun and its khabar, and the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:101-102.t: ﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, the lām prepares for the oath (al-lām al-muwaṭṭiʾa li-l-qasam), and قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿آتَيْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿مُوسى﴾: first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the alif because of impossibility. ﴿تِسْعَ﴾: second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿آياتٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿بَيِّناتٍ﴾: an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿فَسْئَلْ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is conjoined. ﴿بَنِي﴾: mafʿūl bihi, accusative by the yāʾ because it is assimilated to the sound masculine plural. ﴿إِسْرائِيلَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) by the fatḥa because it is a diptote. ﴿إِذْ﴾: an adverb of time. ﴿جاءَهُمْ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the hāʾ is its object; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَقالَ لَهُ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq) to it. ﴿فِرْعَوْنُ﴾: fāʿil, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِنِّي﴾: inna and its noun, and the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿لَأَظُنُّكَ﴾: the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the kāf is its first object; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of inna. ﴿يا مُوسى﴾: يا is a vocative particle, and موسى is a vocative, a single proper noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied ḍamma on the alif because of impossibility, in the position of the accusative as a vocative; the clause has no grammatical position. ﴿مَسْحُوراً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi of أظن. ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَقَدْ﴾: the lām occurs in the answer to an omitted oath, and قد is a particle of realisation. ﴿عَلِمْتَ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿ما أَنْزَلَ﴾: mā is negative, and a past verb. ﴿هؤُلاءِ﴾: the hā is for drawing attention, and أولاء is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿رَبُّ﴾: fāʿil. ﴿السَّماواتِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾: maʿṭūf (conjoined) to السموات, and the clause takes the place of the two objects of علمت. ﴿بَصائِرَ﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial), and the oath clause is in the position of the accusative as the speech reported. ﴿وَإِنِّي﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and inna and its noun; the clause is conjoined. ﴿لَأَظُنُّكَ﴾: the shifted lām, and أظنك is an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the kāf is its first object; the clause is the khabar. ﴿يا فِرْعَوْنُ﴾: يا is a vocative particle, and فرعون is a vocative, indeclinable on the ḍamma. ﴿مَثْبُوراً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi.

daas-irab:103-106.t: ﴿فَأَرادَ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is conjoined. ﴿أَنْ﴾: puts the verb in the accusative. ﴿يَسْتَفِزَّهُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), and the fāʿil is latent, and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); أن يستفزهم and what follows it are in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مِنَ الْأَرْضِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached (mutaʿalliq) to يستفزهم. ﴿فَأَغْرَقْناهُ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its object, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَمَنْ﴾: من is a relative noun conjoined to the hāʾ in أغرقناه. ﴿مَعَهُ﴾: mafʿūl fīhi (adverbial), an adverb of place attached to the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿جَمِيعاً﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَقُلْنا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to قلنا. ﴿لِبَنِي﴾: the lām is a preposition, and بني is genitive (majrūr) by the yāʾ because it is assimilated to the sound masculine plural; the two are attached to قلنا. ﴿إِسْرائِيلَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿اسْكُنُوا الْأَرْضَ﴾: an imperative verb, its fāʿil and its object, and the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿فَإِذا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and إذا is an adverb of time. ﴿جاءَ وَعْدُ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الْآخِرَةِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿جِئْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the speech reported [Translator's note: so in the source; it is the apodosis of إذا within the reported speech]. ﴿بِكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to جئنا. ﴿لَفِيفاً﴾: ḥāl. ﴿وَبِالْحَقِّ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to أنزلناه. ﴿أَنْزَلْناهُ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its object, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَبِالْحَقِّ نَزَلَ﴾: conjoined to what preceded, and its i'rab is like it; the fāʿil of نزل is latent. ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and mā is negative. ﴿أَرْسَلْناكَ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its object, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿مُبَشِّراً﴾: ḥāl. ﴿وَنَذِيراً﴾: maʿṭūf (conjoined) to مبشرا. ﴿وَقُرْآناً﴾: mafʿūl bihi of an omitted verb explained by the one mentioned, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَرَقْناهُ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its object, and the clause is explicative (mufassira). ﴿لِتَقْرَأَهُ﴾: the lām is the lām of cause (taʿlīl), and an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied an after it, and its fāʿil is latent, and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; the lām and what follows it are a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to فرقناه. ﴿عَلَى النَّاسِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تقرأه. ﴿عَلى مُكْثٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿وَنَزَّلْناهُ تَنْزِيلًا﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil, its object and a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:107-109.t: ﴿قُلْ آمِنُوا﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and the clause is resumptive; and an imperative verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿بِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached (mutaʿalliq) to آمنوا. ﴿أَوْ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿لا﴾: prohibitive. ﴿تُؤْمِنُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive lā, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِنَّ﴾: a particle resembling the verb. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun in the position of the accusative as the noun of inna. ﴿أُوتُوا الْعِلْمَ﴾: a passive past verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and it is its first object, and العلم is its second object. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أوتوا, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿إِذا﴾: an adverb of time. ﴿يُتْلى﴾: a passive imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif because of impossibility, and the nāʾib fāʿil is latent; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يتلى. ﴿يَخِرُّونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of إذا; إذا and its two clauses are in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of inna, and the inna clause gives the reason (taʿlīliyya) and has no grammatical position. ﴿لِلْأَذْقانِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يخرون. ﴿سُجَّداً﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَيَقُولُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿سُبْحانَ﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb. ﴿رَبِّنا﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, and نا is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِنْ﴾: lightened (mukhaffafa) from inna, and its noun is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn). ﴿كانَ وَعْدُ﴾: kāna and its noun, and the clause is the khabar of in. ﴿رَبِّنا﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, and نا is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لَمَفْعُولًا﴾: the lām that distinguishes between negation and affirmation (al-fāriqa), and ﴿مفعولا﴾ is the khabar of kāna; the clause is the khabar of in. ﴿وَيَخِرُّونَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the clause is conjoined. ﴿لِلْأَذْقانِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يخرون. ﴿يَبْكُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is a ḥāl, i.e. "باكين" (weeping). ﴿وَيَزِيدُهُمْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the hāʾ is its first object. ﴿خُشُوعاً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:110-111.t: ﴿قُلِ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿ادْعُوا اللَّهَ﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil, and the Divine Name is its object. ﴿أَوِ ادْعُوا الرَّحْمنَ﴾: conjoined to what precedes it, and its i'rab is like it. ﴿أَيًّا﴾: a conditional noun that puts the verb in the jussive, in the position of the accusative as a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿ما﴾: redundant (zāʾida). ﴿تَدْعُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the fiʿl al-sharṭ (protasis). ﴿فَلَهُ﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq) to a fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿الْأَسْماءُ﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿الْحُسْنى﴾: an adjective (ṣifa), and the clause is in the position of the jussive as the jawāb al-sharṭ (apodosis). ﴿وَلا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and lā is prohibitive. ﴿تَجْهَرْ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive, and the fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined. ﴿بِصَلاتِكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تجهر, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَلا تُخافِتْ﴾: conjoined to ولا تجهر, and its i'rab is like its i'rab. ﴿بِها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تخافت. ﴿وَابْتَغِ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperative verb, indeclinable on the deletion of the weak letter, and its fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined. ﴿بَيْنَ﴾: an adverb of place attached to ابتغ. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾: ذا is a demonstrative, muḍāf ilayhi, the lām is for distance and the kāf is for address. ﴿سَبِيلًا﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَقُلِ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿الْحَمْدُ﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿لِلَّهِ﴾: the Divine Name, genitive (majrūr) by the lām; the two are attached to the khabar, and the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿الَّذِي﴾: a relative noun in the position of the genitive as an adjective. ﴿لَمْ يَتَّخِذْ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive by lam, and its fāʿil is latent. ﴿وَلَداً﴾: mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَلَمْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and lam is a particle of jussive, negation and conversion (to the past). ﴿يَكُنْ﴾: an imperfect incomplete (nāqiṣ) verb. ﴿لَهُ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the fronted khabar. ﴿شَرِيكٌ﴾: the noun of يكن. ﴿فِي الْمُلْكِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to شريك. ﴿وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ وَلِيٌّ﴾: its i'rab is like the preceding one, and it is conjoined to it. ﴿وَكَبِّرْهُ تَكْبِيراً﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the hāʾ is its object, and تكبيرا is mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); the clause is conjoined.
